notes.title: Version 1.0.83
notes.content:
5 new arenas and a reworked training arena!  
- New reserve mana mechanic  
- New +1 card per mana mechanic  
- Now after a character is destroyed, its mana moves to the reserve mana pool  
- Improved mechanics for some cards  
- Damage explosion now deals damage more effectively relative to the center  
- Daily roulette  
- Bug fixes  
- And much more

notes.title: Update 1.0.82
notes.content:
-10 new weapons!
-5 battle decks instead of one
-Improved interface
-Effect durations like poison are now displayed above characters and stack
-Electric cards now create chain reactions
-Healing cards now remove a number of effects based on their mana cost
-Explosion card damage now scales based on distance from the center of the character
-Fixed kill registration when pushing a character into water
-New store tab with special deals – buy characters, cards, and more
-Other bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Version 1.0.81 is here!
notes.content:
- Three new weapons (Harpoon, Grenade, Poison Cloud)
- Two jumps now cost no mana!
- All cannons are now adjustable
- Added upgrades for jump strength, melee knockback, and more
- Improved upgrade interface
- Medkit now cures poison
- Poison now stacks
- Canister and dynamite are now more stable
- You can search for friends by nickname
- Other improvements and bug fixes
